cohort: All 67 previously frozen OKX touch_close scored first symbol/NY-week/side signals strictly above 0.5, all instruments, including 29 equity/ETF swaps, with no wick or portfolio admission filter.
entry: The first 1m close at or after the recorded scored_ms, excluding the entry candle from subsequent excursions. Early score timestamps include historical monitor reconstruction.
price_rules: One nominal R = 3% of entry. Round stop towards entry and limit targets away from entry to instrument tick. Hold to initial stop, target, or latest confirmed minute at price_cutoff; unresolved trades stay open. Stop first on ambiguous minute unless the opening price already crosses a barrier. Stop-minute MFE conservatively includes only its open, plus possible upper bound using the full minute if not gapped.
engine: VectorBT OHLC first_hit and Portfolio.from_orders; unlevered independent unit exposures, plus chronological one-position schedule separately by target.
